question: A map file's first mapping never waits behind table files for a table-lane slot (PLAN Done point 3).
cause: docs/evidence/step-9/s9-5d/result.json: in rehearsal 2 run 3 the converted city layer's chunk-mapping waited
8.7 s (75.87 to 84.53 s) because two table files' chunk mappings held both table-lane slots.

claimQuery: processing.ts dispatchTick: map_mapping is a chunk-mapping whose top-level item is vector or model3d and has
no published part; it ranks after first_part and ahead of batch order. The window also carries map_waiting
and table_waiting (bool_or over every ranked row, before LIMIT 12).
admission: dispatch-lanes.ts DispatchReservations: keepTableLaneWaiting(map, table) each tick; overTableShare refuses a
table-lane job when its own kind already holds concurrency minus one slots while the other kind waits. Not
a memory refusal, so no head-of-line wait starts. With nothing of the other kind waiting, each uses the lane.
familySource: Read from the job's intake item (usp_intake_items.family), not the payload: ChunkMappingInputSchema is a
strict contract, and adding a field there is a contract change. A job with no item counts as a table's.
change.unchanged: No lane concurrency, memory, scratch or heap reservation changed; dispatchPoolSize unchanged (26).

offline: selection ranks the layer mapping ahead of two older table mappings; a published part or no item does not
two table mappings running, map queued: the freed slot goes to the map, not a third table
map refused for memory still keeps its slot; no lane gains a slot
no map waiting (or jobs from before the flag): two table mappings run together
fairness: six map mappings in a row while one table mapping holds its slot throughout
